Title: Guidance & Self-Sufficiency
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
Transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-huda wa al-tuqa wa al-'afafa wa al-ghina
Meaning: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.
Why This Dua: Start the month asking for the foundations of a good life.

Title: Good in Both Worlds
Arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
Transliteration: Rabbana atina fi al-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhab al-nar
Meaning: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the Fire.
Why This Dua: The Prophet ﷺ made this dua frequently. It covers everything.

Title: Relief from Worry
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
Transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-hammi wa al-hazan
Meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief.
Why This Dua: Let go of anxiety. Give your worries to Allah.

Title: Ease in Affairs
Arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
Transliteration: Rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri
Meaning: My Lord, expand my chest and ease my affairs.
Why This Dua: Musa's dua before speaking to Pharaoh. Ask for ease in everything.

Title: Help in Worship
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
Transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
Meaning: O Allah, help me remember You, be grateful to You, and worship You well.
Why This Dua: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to Mu'adh. The core of worship.

Title: Knowledge Provision & Acceptance
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
Transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an wa rizqan tayyiban wa 'amalan mutaqabbala
Meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
Why This Dua: Made after Fajr. Covers knowledge wealth and deeds.

Title: Protection of Guidance
Arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً
Transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah
Meaning: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy.
Why This Dua: Protect your guidance. Hearts can change.

Title: Complete Forgiveness
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
Transliteration: Allahumma ighfir li dhanbi kullahu diqqahu wa jillahu wa awwalahu wa akhirah
Meaning: O Allah, forgive all my sins — small and great, first and last.
Why This Dua: Leave no sin behind. Ask for complete forgiveness.

Title: Paradise & Protection from Fire
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
Transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-jannah wa a'udhu bika min al-nar
Meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge from the Fire.
Why This Dua: Simple. Powerful. The ultimate ask.

Title: Rectify My Religion
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي
Transliteration: Allahumma aslih li dini alladhi huwa 'ismatu amri
Meaning: O Allah, set right my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs.
Why This Dua: Your deen protects everything else.

Title: Gratitude
Arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ
Transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'mataka allati an'amta 'alayya
Meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You bestowed upon me.
Why This Dua: Sulayman's dua. Gratitude unlocks more blessings.

Title: Protection from Evil
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ
Transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri ma 'amiltu wa min sharri ma lam a'mal
Meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done and what I have not done.
Why This Dua: Protection from consequences of actions.

Title: All Good
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ
Transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min al-khayri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi
Meaning: O Allah, I ask You for all good — immediate and in the future.
Why This Dua: Comprehensive. Covers all good now and later.

Title: Righteous Family
Arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ
Transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yun
Meaning: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes.
Why This Dua: For family. Ask for righteous spouse and children.

Title: Good Endings (HALFWAY!)
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا
Transliteration: Allahumma ahsin 'aqibatana fi al-umuri kulliha
Meaning: O Allah, make good the end of all our affairs.
Why This Dua: Halfway through Ramadan! Ask for a strong finish.

Title: Against Laziness
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
Transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-'ajzi wa al-kasal
Meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from inability and laziness.
Why This Dua: Fight the mid-Ramadan slump. Ask for energy.

Title: Guidance & Steadfastness
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
Transliteration: Allahumma ihdini wa saddidni
Meaning: O Allah, guide me and keep me on the right path.
Why This Dua: Short and powerful.

Title: Increase in Knowledge
Arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
Transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
Meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
Why This Dua: The ONLY thing Allah told the Prophet ﷺ to ask for more of.

Title: Love of Allah
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ
Transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuk
Meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Your love and the love of those who love You.
Why This Dua: Love of Allah is the highest station.

Title: Reaching Laylatul Qadr
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْنَا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ
Transliteration: Allahumma ballighna laylat al-qadr
Meaning: O Allah, let us reach Laylatul Qadr.
Why This Dua: Last 10 nights begin! Ask to reach them.

Title: THE Laylatul Qadr Dua ⭐
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
Transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni
Meaning: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.
Why This Dua: Prophet ﷺ taught this to Aisha for Laylatul Qadr. REPEAT EVERY ODD NIGHT.

Title: Steadfastness
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الثَّبَاتَ فِي الْأَمْرِ
Transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-thabata fi al-amr
Meaning: O Allah, I ask You for steadfastness in my affairs.
Why This Dua: Stay strong. Don't fade in the final stretch.

Title: Laylatul Qadr Dua ⭐
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
Transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni
Meaning: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.
Why This Dua: Odd night! Go all in with duas tonight.

Title: Best Ending
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ عُمُرِي آخِرَهُ وَخَيْرَ عَمَلِي خَوَاتِمَهُ
Transliteration: Allahumma ij'al khayra 'umuri akhirahu wa khayra 'amali khawatimah
Meaning: O Allah, make the best of my life its end, and the best of my deeds their conclusion.
Why This Dua: The ending matters most. Finish strong.

Title: Laylatul Qadr Dua ⭐
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
Transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni
Meaning: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.
Why This Dua: Odd night! Many scholars say 25th is likely.

Title: Freedom from Fire
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعْتِقْ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ النَّارِ
Transliteration: Allahumma a'tiq raqabati min al-nar
Meaning: O Allah, free my neck from the Fire.
Why This Dua: Every night Allah frees people from Fire. Ask to be one.

Title: MOST LIKELY LAYLATUL QADR ⭐⭐
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
Transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni
Meaning: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.
Why This Dua: GO ALL IN TONIGHT. Make every dua. Don't sleep!

Title: Acceptance
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
Transliteration: Allahumma taqabbal minna innaka anta al-sami' al-'alim
Meaning: O Allah, accept from us. You are the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
Why This Dua: Ibrahim and Ismail's dua building the Ka'bah.

Title: Last Odd Night ⭐
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
Transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni
Meaning: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.
Why This Dua: Last odd night. Could be Laylatul Qadr. Don't miss it!

Title: Among the Saved
Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ عُتَقَائِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
Transliteration: Allahumma ij'alna min 'utaqa'ika min al-nar
Meaning: O Allah, make us among those You have freed from the Fire.
Why This Dua: As Ramadan ends ask to be among the saved. Ameen!
